definition: The subject holds a government-issued electronic identity credential.
The subject's identity has been established to a stated level of assurance by the relying party.
The subject holds a reusable attestation that customer due diligence was completed.
The due diligence behind the attestation has been re-evaluated within its validity period.
A contractual relationship exists between the subject and the organisation.
The relying party has established that the subject may contract in their own right. Reached from verified attributes rather than from a credential issued for the purpose.
The subject can reach the service or premises the relationship entitles them to.
A threshold age has been demonstrated to the relying party without disclosing identity. The outcome of an interaction, not something a separate credential attests.
The subject holds a verifiable school-leaving certificate.
The subject is enrolled at a higher education institution.
An employment contract is in force between the subject and an employer.
The supplier holds current quality, conformity or sector accreditations in verifiable form.
The buying organisation has accepted the supplier as eligible to be contracted.
The person in front of the clinician is bound to the correct medical record.
The subject's entitlement to a public service has been demonstrated to the body providing it.
